name: @webdesk/database
description: The SOLE Sequelize model/connection/migration implementation boundary (WDS-011, ADR-0006). Phase 1A ships configuration and interface placeholders ONLY — no Sequelize models, no migrations, no database connection. See docs/architecture/decisions/0006-postgresql-sequelize-architecture.md and 0007-database-provider-independence-east-coast.md. Real implementation is Phase 1B, gated on the Postgres Marketplace provider being confirmed (docs/project-state/setup-input-register.md).
